paragraphs: Gridics converts municipal zoning code text into parcel-level data that people can look at visually. The work is aimed at two audiences, developers choosing sites and cities trying to make their zoning easier to understand.

A patented zoning rules engine processes the data and powers the applications. Underneath it sits a mix of public property data, GIS shapes, and transit data. CodeHUB handles code publishing, letting staff collaborate on, manage, and publish zoning code changes. ZoneCheck is offered as a way to virtualize the zoning and planning front counter. ZoneIQ analyzes development potential and capacity scenarios in real-time 3D.

In Miami, the company built and implemented CodeHUB with the city's planning and zoning departments. It reports that over 60,000 users a year visit that instance for zoning information. For a study commissioned by the Wynwood Business Improvement District, the team modeled over 200,000,000 gsf of maximum buildable area across two proposed transit sites. The company says a city's code text can be digitized in as little as four weeks.
